answer: Re-attestations are stored in forge and willow lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the kernel graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1054 impostors cost 1599 times the honest price and take 9 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
